label: Product quality & accuracy
summary: Positive reviews praise high product quality, softness, and value. Customers expect the products to meet their quality expectations and appreciate timely delivery.

label: Size, fit & availability
summary: Mixed reviews highlight praise for fit, fabric, and variety, but many complain about size mismatches, out‑of‑stock items, and difficult exchanges or returns. Customers expect accurate size availability and hassle‑free returns.

label: Pricing, discounts & value
summary: Customers praise the app’s generous discounts, affordable prices, and good quality items, noting frequent offers and coupons. Many highlight the value for money and quick delivery. A common expectation is for more discount coupons to be available.

label: Wishlist & cart reliability
summary: Users complain about Myntra’s wishlist cap and cart reliability. They feel restricted by a 1000‑item limit and frustration when items become unavailable or price‑shifted after adding to wishlist. Customers expect unlimited wishlisting, stable prices, and consistent stock availability.

label: Delivery, returns & refunds
summary: Customers report frequent delivery delays, wrong or damaged items, failed return pickups, and slow or denied refunds. Poor customer support and inventory mismanagement worsen frustration. Many feel the platform’s policies unfairly penalize them. They expect on‑time delivery and prompt, full refunds for issues.

label: Support, payment & app experience
summary: Positive reviews highlight the app’s ease of use, wide brand selection, fast delivery, and hassle‑free returns. Customers appreciate responsive customer support and smooth payment. Many expect quick delivery and easy returns as key features.
